semiconductor_relevance: High — Innojet Technology specializes in advanced materials and precision manufacturing technologies specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: Innojet Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on advanced materials and precision manufacturing technologies, particularly through its Aerosol Deposition (AD) technology, which is used for creating dense ceramic coatings for semiconductor components. The company also develops amorphous metal manufacturing solutions that enhance the performance and durability of semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Aerosol Deposition (AD) technology for semiconductor coatings
Amorphous metal manufacturing for precision components
